metadata.summary: Gaurav placed an order for a Hot Latte at Manhattan Bagel.

messages.text: Hello Gaurav, Welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It is great to see you again. How can I help you today?
Can I get hot hot latte?
Let me see what I can find for you.
Found 3 item(s) for your search: Hot Latte, Iced Latte, HOT Coffee or Tea . See 'item_details' for more information.
I found a Hot Latte for you. The price is $2.49. Would you like to add any flavor shots to that?
No. Just simple. Please stay at the order.
Let me confirm your order. You'd like a Hot Latte for $2.49. Your total comes out to be 249 cents. Is that correct?
Before I place your order, may I have your name for the order, please?
Your total is 249 cents. Anything else you'd like to add or any special instructions?
Ready to place this order for pickup, Gaurav?
Perfect! I've submitted your order. Let me get your confirmation number, this will just take a moment...

Your order number is #1234. Your total is 249 cents, which includes a subtotal of 249 cents and no tax. We will have your order ready for pickup at our store location. Thank you for choosing Manhattan Bagel, have a great day!
